court: In the High Court of Madras†

advocates: For Petitioner: M/s. N. Edwin Jeyakumar
For Respondent: Mr. A. Albert James Government Advocate (crl.side)
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS Act, 2023, to file a Final Report before the appropriate Court in Connection with Cr. No. 43 of 2025 pending on the file of respondent police.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

R. Vijayakumar, J.:— The present petition has been filed seeking a direction as against the respondent to file a final report in Crime No. 43 of 2025.

2. The learned government advocate (crl.side) appearing for the respondent submits that they would file a final report within 3(three) months.

3. Recording the same, the Criminal Original Petition stands closed with a direction to the respondent to file a final report within a period of 3(three) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
